mapper.insert: insert into crowd_tags_job(tag_id, batch_id, tag_type, tag_rule, stat_start_time, stat_end_time, last_execute_time, status, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{tagId}, #{batchId}, #{tagType}, #{tagRule}, #{statStartTime}, #{statEndTime}, #{lastExecuteTime}, #{status}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, tag_id, batch_id, tag_type, tag_rule, stat_start_time, stat_end_time, last_execute_time, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from crowd_tags_job where tag_id = #{tagId} and batch_id = #{batchId} and is_del = 0 limit 1
select id, tag_id, batch_id, tag_type, tag_rule, stat_start_time, stat_end_time, last_execute_time, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from crowd_tags_job where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.update: update crowd_tags_job set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
update crowd_tags_job set is_del = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
